build.description: Format-centric build executor with explicit output configuration.

typecheck.description: Run TypeScript type checking without emitting files.

publish.description: Publish library packages to npm registry with dry-run support.

version.description: Versioning executor using @hyperfrontend/versioning. Uses npm registry as source of truth.

version-batch.description: Run versioning for all affected libraries and create a single batch commit.

version-check.description: Validates version state without changes. Used by CI to verify lefthook versioning.

e2e.description: Test package build outputs via npm pack + tarball install.
